segments.text: The next password is delivered by a scheduled job: a cron job runs every minute as bandit twenty-two.
I log in as bandit21 with ssh bandit21@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
Cron definitions live in etc cron dot d, so I read the job for bandit twenty-two.
It runs every minute as bandit twenty-two, and also at reboot.
I read the script it runs.
The script makes a file in temp readable, then copies bandit twenty-two's password into it.
The note names the file: temp slash t7O6lds9S0RqQh9aMcz6ShpAoZKF7fgv, refreshed every minute.
Out comes the password for bandit twenty-two, and the level is solved.
